reason: pinned 2026-09-09: Added only chipdb/selector_alias_repair.csv and its research inventory entry. INERT by default -- features/routing.py reads it only under AGAMEMNON_ALIAS_REPAIR=1 -- so the default graph, admission and every codeword are byte unchanged, and Rule 2 confirms every included retained artifact still rebuilds byte-identical. Enabling the repair is NOT covered by this pin -- it removes ~6k rows, moves graph_pip_count and needs retained artifacts re-qualified, which is why it ships opt-in. Evidence: AG32-Docs docs/BRAM_SELECTOR_ALIASING_ROOTCAUSE_20260909.md and tools/vendor_parity/bram_alias_repair_planes_20260909.
